mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_alert (user_id, alert_level, model_name, current_value, content, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{alertLevel}, #{modelName}, #{currentValue}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, alert_level, model_name, current_value, content, status, create_time FROM health_alert WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, alert_level, model_name, current_value, content, status, create_time FROM health_alert WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND alert_level = #{alertLevel} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM health_alert WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{daysAgo} DAY)
